identity: Dawnmere feeds the road to Highcourt, but boars, rats and a remarkably confused requisition gang are eating the harvest first.

quests.title: Crop Thieves
quests.text: Small Boars are eating next winter's bread in the {name:home_fields} {dir_of:dawnmere:home_fields}. Hunt eight by day; their yellow names mean they fight back only when struck. A fellow called Crumb has been helping himself to our grain too, but let us begin with the thieves who cannot read.
quests.lesson: Yellow names are neutral: they only fight back. Save the meat.

quests.title: The Night Shift
quests.text: The day's work ends, and the gnawing begins: Large Rats come out after sunset in the {name:meadows}, which lie {zone_area:meadows}. Kill eight there at night. Their red names mean they will not wait to be introduced, so watch the grass as well as the one in front of you.
quests.lesson: Night rosters differ from day rosters; red names attack on sight.

quests.title: Foxes Before Breakfast
quests.text: Our hens have taken to sleeping with one eye open, thanks to the Young Foxes in the {name:pastures}, which lie {zone_area:pastures}. Hunt eight by day. Watch for Aggressive Boars among them: a red name means the creature will start the fight without waiting for you.
quests.lesson: Yellow foxes next to a red minor role: pick your pulls.

quests.title: Five Claws Too Many
quests.text: The fishermen came back from the {name:wreck_coast} {dir_from_giver:wreck_coast} with empty nets and some very firm opinions about Monstrous Crabs. Kill five there by day so our folk can try their luck again. Go while the sun is up; the drowned dead walk that shore after dark, and I would rather you came home for supper.
quests.lesson: Scarce shore target, five only; the shore changes owner at night.

quests.title: Requisition for One Crumb
quests.text: {name:confused_bandit_chief} calls our missing grain a requisition, though he cannot say who requisitioned it. Find the {name:bandit_camp} {dir_from_giver:bandit_camp} and defeat seven Confused Bandits, then Crumb himself. They keep their posts day and night; draw the chief away from his collectors if you can. We planted that harvest, and our people ought to eat it.
quests.lesson: A camp pack plus a named normal leader; pull them apart.

quests.title: The Next Sack of Grain
quests.text: Crumb's accounts point to more missing grain in Goldmead Vale; this reaches beyond our fields. Follow the road into the vale and tell Marta Millward in Goldmead Village what happened here. Finish your preparations before you go, and remember that a full pack beats a brave speech on a long road.
quests.lesson: Start zone to home zone handoff.

quests.title: Two Hands, Two Tools
quests.text: Make a Wooden Axe and a Wooden Pickaxe from wood, then bring both to me here in Dawnmere. I will check your work and give you a working pair in return. A sword looks splendid over a hearth, but somebody still has to chop the firewood.
quests.lesson: Grid tools; handed-in tools are replaced by the reward.

quests.title: A Stone Edge
quests.text: Those wooden tools have earned their keep; let us put a better edge on your next day's work. Use your wooden pick on suitable rock outside Dawnmere, then make a Stone Axe and a Stone Pickaxe and bring both to me. In return you get a pair that has already proved itself on Dawnmere's rock; the ore ahead deserves tools with a little experience.
quests.lesson: Tool progression; check the rock's pick tier.

quests.title: Metal for the Mending
quests.text: Every loose hinge in Dawnmere seems to find its way onto my list. Smelt three Copper Bars and three Tin Bars from the local ore, then bring them to me for the town repairs. I will give you a Dual Furnace for your own work; set it outside protected ground, where it will not become my next complaint.
quests.lesson: Ore to bar; bars handed in are consumed.

quests.title: Bronze for the Road
quests.text: You have helped mend the town; now we ought to see you properly equipped for the road. Make three Bronze Bars from fresh copper and tin in your Dual Furnace and bring them to me. The earlier bars went into our repairs, so you will need another batch. A Bronze Pickaxe will be your share of the work.
quests.lesson: Alloys; the Bronze Pickaxe opens the next rock tier.

quests.title: The Rats Can Mend It
quests.text: The Large Rats have chewed my grain sacks, and I intend to make them contribute to the repairs. Bring me two Rat Fur Patches from them in the {name:meadows} after dark; any you saved from your hunt will do. Yes, we are patching rat holes with rat fur. I call that good housekeeping.
quests.lesson: Ordinary loot has uses; collect while hunting.

quests.title: A Brush and a Better Supper
quests.text: I have a flour shelf to dust and a supper to rescue. Bring me two Crab Legs from the Monstrous Crabs on the {name:wreck_coast} {dir_from_giver:wreck_coast}, and one Fox Tail from the Young Foxes in the {name:pastures}; hunt both by day. Legs for the pot, tail for the shelf, and keep the Crab Eyes for yourself. I have enough people watching me cook.
quests.lesson: Keep what your enchants need, hand in what they do not.

quests.title: Five Logs, Any Tree
quests.text: Bring me five logs from any tree outside Dawnmere, whenever your hands are free. The oven needs fuelwood, not a debate about which tree is fashionable. Leave the trees inside town alone; I will not have my supper blamed for a missing village green.
quests.lesson: Any log counts; town plants are protected.

quests.title: A Proper Fire
quests.text: An oven full of good intentions still serves a cold dinner. Bring me five Coal Lumps from the rock outside Dawnmere when your hunts leave you time. At the public oven, coal goes in the fuel slot and raw food in the cooking slot; get those right and we can call you useful in two trades.
quests.lesson: Gather while you wait for night; the public oven is in town.

quests.title: The Smokehouse Share
quests.text: Bring ten cuts of Raw Meat from your hunts to my kitchen here in Dawnmere; anything you saved already counts. Boars and foxes provide it by day, rats after dark, and I have mouths to feed at every hour. I will cook a share for you to take along. Heroes run on supper, whatever the songs say.
quests.lesson: Earlier hunt loot is useful; raw food cooks in the oven.
